Appearance

Tall and sturdy, sun-kissed skin from years in the vineyards. Short curly brown hair, calloused but gentle hands. Wears traditional vintner clothing.

What We Know

Stubbornly traditional master vintner and protector of ancestral wine-making knowledge. One of the most influential voices in Hillcrest.

First Impressions

A proud craftsman who takes his heritage very seriously.
